historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 6.6% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 2.7% (>30% divergence): book has compounded on retained earnings and the deposit pile while per-share earnings are flat versus the FY2020 peak (3.40 -> 3.88). Owner FCF fell on a 3- and 5-year view because capex rose with the Vietnam/Cambodia/Indonesia build-out (8.8% of revenue in FY2025 vs 4.4% in FY2023).
historical_growth.notes: FCF series = OCF - capex (PP&E + land-use-right prepayments + intangibles). SBC is zero and interest received is in investing activities, so owner FCF = reported FCF on every year; owner and reported CAGRs coincide. FY2017-FY2025 revenue CAGR 7.0%.

scenario_narratives.base: Demand trough in 2026, then a steady recovery. Shenzhou's four anchor customers (Nike, Adidas, Fast Retailing/Uniqlo, Puma) keep consolidating supply toward scaled, vertically integrated vendors, so share gains offset a muted end market; the Indonesia garment base and Vietnam fabric capacity carry mid-single-digit growth. Margins recover from the 2026 hit (RMB appreciation, wage and pension inflation, synthetic-fibre costs) to ~23% operating EBITDA as new plants reach efficiency, but not to the 27-28% of the China-centric era, because overseas labour is less productive and brands push tariff costs back onto vendors.
scenario_narratives.bull: Brand inventory restocking returns in 2027, Nike's turnaround lifts its sourcing volumes, and Shenzhou's share of wallet rises as the brands concentrate orders in the few suppliers with fabric-to-garment capacity outside China. Indonesia and Cambodia ramp quickly, RMB stabilises against the USD, and margins rebuild to ~25.5% - still below the FY2019-20 peak - with high-single-digit growth for four years.
scenario_narratives.bear: Customer concentration bites: Nike or Adidas cuts or diversifies orders, US tariff policy squeezes vendor pricing further (Section 301 on China, reciprocal tariffs on Vietnam/Cambodia), and the RMB keeps appreciating against the USD revenue base. Revenue falls ~6% in 2026, is flat in 2027 and grows only at low single digits thereafter; operating EBITDA margin settles at ~18% (near the FY2021 Vietnam-shutdown trough) as overseas wage inflation and under-utilised new plants persist.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, SBC-free, vertically integrated apparel manufacturer valued on unlevered owner FCF in CNY, with RMB13.2bn of net deposit-type financial assets added once in the bridge and the interest they earn kept out of the flows. The share price has roughly halved from its 52-week high on the H1 FY2026 profit drop; the model asks whether that drop is a cyclical/FX trough (base) or a structural de-rating of the margin (bear).
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: Nike, Adidas, Fast Retailing and Puma are the large majority of sales; losing share at any one moves value materially.
RMB/USD: revenue is USD-priced and ~93% of cash is USD; a further RMB appreciation compresses margins and the RMB value of the deposit pile.
US tariff policy on China and Southeast Asia (Section 301, reciprocal tariffs) and brand pressure to share tariff costs.
Overseas wage and pension inflation in Vietnam and Cambodia and the ramp efficiency of the Indonesia plant.
Terminal value carries most of the value; the 14x cap binds in the base case.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (2313.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 33.14-73.00 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X, cross-checked against USDHKD=X / USDCNY=X.
data_sources.financials: 2313.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) and kpis; FY2025 Annual Report consolidated statement of cash flows; H1 FY2026 Interim Report (balance sheet, liquidity and financial resources, EPS note).
data_sources.qualitative: 2313.HK_Analysis.json (bull_case, bear_case, risks) plus FY2025 Annual Report and H1 FY2026 Interim Report MD&A (industry review, reasons for profit decline, future prospects).

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,503,222,397 ordinary shares in issue less 386,400 treasury shares at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, EPS note). No options, RSUs or convertibles outstanding, so basic = diluted. Held FLAT: no SBC, and the only buyback (RMB15.9m in H1 FY2026) is immaterial.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim. Debt = bank borrowings RMB14,762.0m (14,565.0 short-term + 197.0 long-term) + lease liabilities RMB151.4m (lease treatment A). Cash = 'deposit-type financial assets' RMB28,095.7m = cash & equivalents 15,280.0 + other deposit financial assets 12,815.7 (bank deposits >3 months plus principal-guaranteed bank financial products at FVTPL), per the interim's liquidity section. Company's own net deposit-type figure is RMB13,333.7m before leases. ~93% of cash and equivalents are USD-denominated, so the bridge value moves with USD/CNY.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income was RMB1,094.8m in FY2025 (RMB568.7m in H1 FY2026), but Shenzhou classifies interest RECEIVED (RMB1,391.6m FY2025) in INVESTING activities, so reported FCF (OCF - capex) already excludes it; deducting it again would double-strip. Interest PAID (RMB326.5m) sits inside OCF, so reported FCF is levered and slightly conservative relative to the unlevered forward build. The forward EBITDA path is set EX interest income (CSV EBITDA includes it), so the deposit pile is counted once, in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment expense in any FY2017-FY2025 annual or H1 interim cash-flow statement or equity note; EquityAwardTaxes 0 every period. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide.
inputs.fx_note: Statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1724 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16 close. Parity cross-check: USDHKD=X 7.8479 / USDCNY=X 6.6768 = 1.1754, a 0.26% tie, confirming direction (HKD per CNY). All flows and the bridge are modelled in CNY; per-share values are converted to HKD at 1.1724. refresh_price.py does not update this rate - re-fetch on any refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY (the flows' currency): China 10y government yield ~1.9% + equity beta ~1.0 x ERP ~6.5% (mature-market ERP plus China country premium) = ~8.4% cost of equity; rounded to 9.0% because a large share of profits and assets now sit in Vietnam/Cambodia (higher-risk jurisdictions) and revenue is USD-priced. Company is net cash, so WACC ~= cost of equity. Same WACC in every scenario: customer-concentration, tariff and FX risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease principal (RMB49.2m FY2025) is NOT deducted from flows (post-IFRS-16 EBITDA, ROU depreciation inside D&A); lease liabilities RMB151.4m added to total_debt once. Immaterial either way (~0.1 HKD/share).
inputs.nci_treatment: Immaterial: non-controlling interests in the equity statement are in the RMB low-tens-of-millions (e.g. RMB12.9m movement, FY2023/24 annual) against RMB37bn attributable equity, and the CSV net income is attributable. No NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (CNY/HKD dual currency, SBC-zero, net-deposit bridge). Routing: Shenzhou is a vertically integrated knit-apparel OEM (fabric + garment) for Nike, Adidas, Uniqlo/Fast Retailing and Puma - an operating manufacturer whose value is a free-cash-flow stream; not a financial, REIT or holdco. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry). EBITDA margin paths are OPERATING EBITDA EX interest income: FY2025 8,486 - 1,095 = 7,391 (23.8%); FY2024 9,056 - 1,076 - 373 one-off right-of-use disposal gain = 7,607 (26.5%); FY2019-20 27.5-28.3% (China-centric peak); FY2021 20.5% (Vietnam COVID shutdown); H1 FY2026 2,930 - 569 = 2,361 (16.7%, including FX revaluation losses on USD balances from ~4% RMB appreciation). FY2026 is half-reported: H1 revenue -5.3% in RMB (-1.8% in USD), gross margin 22.6% vs 27.1%, attributable profit -40%. No numeric guidance is given by management. Working capital capture is NEGATIVE (-30% of the revenue change): inventories 7,317 + receivables 6,101 - trade payables 1,533 = ~RMB11.9bn, ~40% of revenue, so growth consumes cash and the FY2026 revenue decline releases some. Buybacks: RMB15.9m in H1 FY2026 only; the flat count is a convention here, not a funded programme. Dividends ~60% payout (RMB3.67bn FY2025). Drivers were set from the FY2025 annual and H1 FY2026 interim MD&A; 2313.HK_Analysis.json arrived before finalisation and its bull/bear points (customer concentration ~80% in four brands, RMB/USD mismatch, tariffs, overseas ramp execution, vertical-integration share gains) match the scenario axes - no driver changed as a result.

base.rationale: FY2026 -4%: H1 -5.3% plus a flat-to-slightly-down H2 against a strong H2 FY2025 (RMB16.0bn). Recovery to mid-single-digit growth as Indonesia (construction from Sept 2026, phased start) and the second Tay Ninh fabric mill add capacity, below the 7.0% FY2017-25 CAGR because China/US apparel demand is subdued. Operating EBITDA margin 19% in FY2026 (H1 16.7% incl. FX losses, H2 better), recovering to 23% - below the 26-28% China-centric history because overseas labour costs and tariffs-driven pricing pressure are structural. Capex 8.5% during the Indonesia build, easing to 5.5% (above ~4.8% D&A to fund growth). Cash tax 15% (FY2025 cash taxes 14.4% of PBT; Pillar Two minimum floor). Cap 14x binds just below Gordon (~14.6x).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because ~80% of revenue comes from four brand customers and the US tariff regime is unresolved; the H1 FY2026 margin collapse shows the bear axis is live, not hypothetical. Base 50% as the central recovery path. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things at once: demand restocking, a Nike recovery, a stable RMB and fast new-plant ramps. No WACC premium is stacked on top - risk is charged here, once.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
